name: Stonegear's Search
label: Quest
description: At Steelgrill's Depot, Pilot Stonegear seeks a rare ore for his tank. He asks a daring traveler to find fresh fuel for its weapons.

clips.title: The story
paras: At Steelgrill's Depot, Pilot Stonegear seeks a rare ore for his tank. He asks a daring traveler to find fresh fuel for its weapons.

Pilot Stonegear, stationed just outside Ironforge, wants to make his siege engine more powerful. Word of his plans spreads through Ironforge and Loch Modan. Pilot Longbeard or Mountaineer Kadrell may send you to meet the ambitious pilot and hear his proposal.

Pilot Stonegear works at Steelgrill's Depot, a proving ground and staging yard along the road just east of Kharanos. He seeks prospectors willing to search for a rare, volatile ore. He believes it can greatly increase his tank's firepower.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Pilot Stonegear loves his siege engine, as every pilot should! And he's always eager to find new ways to improve his tank's firepower!
He heard rumors of a rare ore and is looking for someone to hunt it down for him. If your boots are starting to itch, then find Stonegear at Steelgrill's Depot in Dun Morogh and see what he wants.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hello friend. You're here about the task I have, eh? It's good to see a young traveler like yourself whose blood burns at the prospect of adventure!
